description: If the workspace has no funding, offer the complimentary Visibility Check first (socialseal_start_visibility_check). When this action returns reason funding_required with suggestedTool, it did not run: relay its text, collect what missing lists, and once the user agrees call that tool with suggestedArguments plus brand as locator, market as market and the business's own website as targetWebsiteUrl. Retrieve assets for stored post identifiers. TikTok photo/carousel posts return ordered signed slide images; video posts return video/frame assets. Missing frame extraction or requested analysis may incur processing cost under existing controls. Returns per-item state and source links; poll analysis by returned ID, not URL. Separate observed hooks/shots/transcripts from model interpretations. Photo/carousel analysis uses one-based slideIndex references; it provides no video timing, motion or audio evidence. likelyReasonItRanks and similar explanations are hypotheses, not measured ranking causes or independent proof of effectiveness. Cite the source post and inspect whether its audience, topic and production context transfer to the requested brief. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.
